notes: Fixes two rep-detection bugs found on real captures: meanVelocity/meanAcceleration/quality1 silently reporting 0 past a certain rep, and rep counting permanently stalling on sets with no real pause between reps - both triggered once accumulated raw drift grew large enough. Also adds a configurable anti-shock filter so briefly setting the bar down (touch-and-go) no longer corrupts the velocity reading for that rep. Update the companion app too - it adds the new anti-shock threshold to Settings.
